The symbolic checker reproduces critical arithmetic but does not substitute for these geometric arguments.

value.rationale: The thirty newly classified quasi-Galois reflections naturally ask what their quotient surfaces are. The K3 nature, five-arm sublattice and exact reducible degeneration of a primitive genus-six polarization give an intrinsic and motivatable geometric invariant, not a routine degree substitution or arbitrary finite slice. The exceptional multiplicity five encodes the intersection of five invariant Fermat lines and distinguishes this special K3 model. Picard completeness is not claimed.
